g.text: 1. fast-slow find middle point and separate it evenly
the second head is on slow -> next (ListNode* secHead = slow -> next)
熟記 Reverse the linked list 的方法！！！
1. declare curr = head, prev = nullptr, nextNode = nullptr
2. while(curr ≠ nullptr): {nextNode = curr -> next; curr -> next = prev; prev = curr; curr = nextNode;}
